news.content: A paper on AIGC evaluation was accepted by AAAI.
I passed my Ph.D. thesis defense! Cheers.

news.content_html: Compare2Score was accepted by NeurIPS'24 as a Spotlight.
A paper on full-reference image quality assessment (DMM) was accepted by TMM.
A paper on deep shape-texture statistics for opinion-unaware BIQA (DSTS) was accepted by TOMM.
Co-Instruct was selected for an Oral presentation.
Our paper on 2AFC prompting of LMMs for IQA (2AFC-LMM) was accepted by TCSVT.
Two papers (Co-Instruct and UDU-Net) were accepted by ECCV.
Compare2Score is now available on arXiv.

news.content: A paper on low-light video enhancement was accepted by IJCV.
A paper on image quality assessment was accepted by TIP.
A paper on video quality assessment was accepted by TCSVT.
